newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed, buying in Sony, NTT fizzles.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed, buying in Sony, NTT fizzles.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed mixed on Tuesday. Steadiness in the yen/dollar rate initially stimulated buying in major high-tech shares such as Sony Corp, but the buying momentum ran out of steam later, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 14.40 points or 0.07 percent to 20,129.11. June Nikkei futures gave up 10 points to 20,180.
But the broader TOPIX index finished up 7.22 points or 0.48 percent at 1,500.67. The Nikkei 300 gained 1.17 points or 0.40 percent to 291.03.
The second section index gained 12.92 points to 1,720.25, with 11.14 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index rose 7.21 points to 1,173.87.
